{{Current events|year=2020|month=03|day=12|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Arts and culture
*[[2019–20 coronavirus pandemic]]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Australia]], [[Impact of the 2019–20 coronavirus pandemic on cinema]]
***Actor [[Tom Hanks]] reports that he and his wife [[Rita Wilson]] have been [[diagnose]]d with [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] after visiting Australia where he was filming ''[[Elvis (2021 film)|Elvis]]''. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/03/12/world/australia/tom-hanks-rita-wilson-coronavirus.html (''The New York Times'')]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United States]]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in New York (state)]], [[Impact of the 2019–20 coronavirus pandemic on television#United States|Impact of the 2019–20 coronavirus pandemic on American television]]
****It is announced that all [[Broadway theatre]]s will go dark until the week of April 13, by order of New York Governor [[Andrew Cuomo]]. The ban also affects several television shows which film with live audiences in New York City. [https://www.playbill.com/article/broadway-goes-dark-amid-coronavirus-concerns (''Playbill'')] [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/03/12/business/nbc-jimmy-fallon-seth-meyers.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Business and economy
*[[Black Thursday (2020)|Black Thursday]]; [[socio-economic impact of the 2019–20 coronavirus pandemic]]
**All three major United States trading indexes fall 7% during early trading, leading to a 15-minute [[Trading curb|trading halt]]. They all closed over 9% down. [https://markets.businessinsider.com/news/stocks/stock-market-news-today-index-reaction-coronavirus-trump-travel-ban-2020-3-1028990017 (''Business Insider'')]
**The [[Dow Jones Industrial Average]] falls by 10%, the largest one-day percentage drop since [[Black Monday (1987)|Black Monday]] in 1987. [https://www.cnbc.com/2020/03/11/futures-are-steady-wednesday-night-after-dow-closes-in-bear-market-traders-await-trump.html (CNBC)]
**Spain's [[IBEX 35]] falls 14%, its worst drop in history in a single day. The UK [[FTSE 100 Index|FTSE]] falls by 11%, the German [[DAX]] and French [[CAC 40]] by 12% and Italy's [[FTSE MIB|MIB]] by 17%. [https://www.elcomercio.es/economia/mercados/ibex-afronta-jornada-20200312090857-ntrc.html (''El Comercio'')]
*[[OMV]], the giant Austrian oil and gas concern, is selling $2.3 billion in assets to buy a majority interest in [[Borealis AG]], which will make it a major player in the production of [[polymers]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-borealis-m-a-omv/omv-to-sell-2-3-billion-of-assets-to-fund-purchase-of-plastics-maker-idUSKBN20Z15W (Reuters)]

;Health and environment
*[[2019–20 coronavirus pandemic]]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in India]]
***India's first COVID-19 death is confirmed in [[Karnataka]]. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/india-s-first-coronavirus-death-in-karnataka-confirmed/story-2ZJ6IuxJ38EiGndBq5pfHO.html (''Hindustan Times'')]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Italy]]
***The number of confirmed cases in [[Italy]] climbs to 15,113, while the death toll rose to 1,016. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-51852320 (BBC)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Poland]]
***[[Poland]] suspends all schools and universities, closes all theatres, operas, cinemas and museums for two weeks in response to the coronavirus pandemic. Mass events are also banned, and the [[Polish Football Association]] announces that the two friendly matches scheduled later this month with Finland and Ukraine will be played [[Behind closed doors (sport)|behind closed doors]]. [https://www.pap.pl/en/news/news%2C602846%2Cpoland-shuts-down-all-schools-over-coronavirus.html (PAP)] [https://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-8099501/Poland-closes-schools-museums-cinemas-amid-coronavirus.html (''Daily Mail'')]
***Poland reports the country's first death from [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] in the city of [[Poznań]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-poland-death/poland-reports-first-death-from-coronavirus-idUSKBN20Z1MG (Reuters)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Greece]] 
***Greek authorities reports its first death, a 66-year-old pilgrim who visited [[Israel]] and [[Egypt]] last month. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-greece-death/greece-reports-first-coronavirus-death-66-year-old-man-idUSA8N29K019 (Reuters)] 
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Cuba]]
***[[Cuba]] has confirmed its first three cases of COVID-19. [https://www.miamiherald.com/news/nation-world/world/americas/cuba/article241115931.html?fbclid=IwAR1VNecCKh2DRXhaB-eEdsK4WZGcPM5jZbBD-o8TWf4yEY_s1NRmens4ZTY (Miami Herald)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Spain]]
***[[Spain]]'s [[Ministry of Health (Spain)|Ministry of Health]] reports 828 new confirmed cases of COVID-19 and 36 more deaths, bringing the total number of fatalities in the country to 84. [https://www.news18.com/news/world/spain-coronavirus-toll-soars-to-nearly-3000-cases-with-84-deaths-2535025.html (News18)]
***[[Irene Montero]], [[Ministry of Equality (Spain)|Minister of Equality]] and Deputy, tested positive for coronavirus. Her domestic partner, Second Deputy Prime Minister of Spain [[Pablo Iglesias Turrión|Pablo Iglesias]], self-isolates and all the [[Sánchez II Government|government]] undergo tests. [[Felipe VI of Spain|King Felipe VI]] and [[Queen Letizia of Spain|Queen Letizia]] also undergo tests after the Queen was in contact with Montero on March 6. [https://www.elmundo.es/espana/2020/03/12/5e6a095a21efa06f668b45f3.html (''El Mundo'')] 
***The Catalan government orders the confinement of the city of [[Igualada]] and the towns of [[Vilanova del Camí]], [[Òdena]] and [[Santa Margarida de Montbui]] after Igualada Hospital became a contagion focus. This first measure in Spain will affect 70,000 people during 14 days. [https://elpais.com/espana/catalunya/2020-03-12/ordenan-el-confinamiento-de-la-poblacion-de-igualada-y-tres-municipios-mas-por-el-brote-de-coronavirus.html (''El País'')]
***Spanish [[Ministry for Territorial Administrations|Minister of Territorial Policy and Civil Service]] [[Carolina Darias]] and [[Santiago Abascal]], Deputy and leader of the third political force [[Vox (political party)|Vox]], had tested positive in the disease. [https://www.abc.es/sociedad/abci-coronavirus-ultimas-noticias-casado-considera-medidas-gobierno-insuficientes-202003122053_directo.html (ABC.es)]
***The closure of schools and universities extends to the entire country for two weeks affecting 9.5 million students. [https://www.elmundo.es/espana/2020/03/12/5e6a2011fdddff2c1e8b4574.html (''El Mundo'')]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Lithuania]] 
***The [[Vilnius City Municipality]] announces that from March 13 until the end of the [[Easter]] holidays all educational facilities in the city will remain closed to contain the spread of the virus. [https://www.lrt.lt/naujienos/lietuvoje/2/1150716/vilnius-jau-prieme-sprendima-stabdo-ugdymo-procesa-mokyklose-ir-darzeliuose-uzdaro-viesas-pramogu-erdves (LRT)] 
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Ireland]]
***[[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]] suspends all schools, colleges and childcare facilities until March 29 in response to the coronavirus, while indoor gatherings of more than 100 people and outdoor gatherings of more than 500 people should be cancelled until further notice, according to [[Taoiseach]] [[Leo Varadkar]]. [https://www.irishtimes.com/news/health/coronavirus-schools-colleges-and-childcare-facilities-in-ireland-to-shut-1.4200977 (''The Irish Times'')]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Austria]]
***[[Austria]] reports the country's first death from COVID-19, a 69-year-old man in [[Vienna]]. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-austria/austria-reports-first-coronavirus-death-man-of-69-idUKKBN20Z1D0 (Reuters)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Slovakia]]
***[[Slovakia]] orders the closure of all its borders to non-residents, while closing all international airports and schools to prevent the spread of the virus. [https://news.trust.org/item/20200312123652-ufc6r/ (Reuters)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in the Philippines]]
***[[President of the Philippines|President]] [[Rodrigo Duterte]] announces "community quarantine" in [[Metro Manila]], [[Philippines]], implementing travel restrictions to and from the metropolitan area. [https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/news/nation/729459/code-red-sub-level-2-duterte-announces-tougher-measures-vs-covid-19-threat/story/ (''GMA News'')]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Canada]]
***Canadian Prime Minister [[Justin Trudeau]] and his wife [[Sophie Grégoire]] self-isolate after she shows flu-like symptoms. They are both tested for the [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]], with Sophie later testing positive. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-canada/canadas-trudeau-self-isolates-as-wife-is-tested-for-coronavirus-idUSKBN20Z2A0 (Reuters)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Andorra]]
***Andorran authorities confirms the second case in the country. [https://www.elperiodic.ad/noticia/77791/segon-cas-positiu-per-coronavirus-al-principat (''El Periòdic'')]
***The [[Executive Council of Andorra|Government]] announces that it will close all schools from March 16. [https://www.diariandorra.ad/noticies/nacional/2020/03/12/l_hospital_ailla_dues_persones_mes_per_sospites_haver_infectat_amb_malaltia_158460_1125.html (''Diari d'Andorra'')]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United States]]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Washington, D.C.]]
****After 10 cases of [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] are confirmed in [[Washington, D.C.]], the [[Government of the United States|U.S. government]] closes the [[White House]], the [[United States Capitol|Capitol building]], and the [[United States Supreme Court Building|U.S. Supreme Court Building]] to visitors until the end of the month. [https://www.usnews.com/news/politics/articles/2020-03-12/capitol-white-house-closed-to-public-due-to-coronavirus (''U.S. News and World Report'')]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Washington (state)]]
****[[Washington (state)|Washington]] [[Governor of Washington|Governor]] [[Jay Inslee]] closes all schools in [[King County, Washington|King]], [[Pierce County, Washington|Pierce]], and [[Snohomish County, Washington|Snohomish]] counties until April 24. [https://www.thenewstribune.com/news/article241144791.html (''The News Tribune'')]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in New York (state)]]
****[[New York City]] [[Mayor of New York City|Mayor]] [[Bill de Blasio]] declares a state of emergency. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/03/12/nyregion/coronavirus-nyc-event-ban.html (''The New York Times'')]
***[[United States Senator]]s [[Tom Cotton]] and [[Ted Cruz]] announce that they will temporarily close their offices. [https://thehill.com/homenews/senate/487204-cruz-cotton-close-senate-offices?amp (The Hill)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in California]], [[Impact of the 2019–20 coronavirus pandemic on television#United States|impact of the 2019–20 coronavirus pandemic on American television]]
****[[California]] [[Governor of California|Governor]] [[Gavin Newsom]] bans gatherings of more than 250 people. The ban puts several television shows filmed in the [[Los Angeles metropolitan area]] with live audiences on hiatus. [https://nypost.com/2020/03/12/california-governor-calls-for-all-public-gatherings-to-be-canceled-due-to-coronavirus/ (''New York Post'')] 
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Michigan]]
****After 12 cases of COVID-19 are confirmed in [[Michigan]], [[Governor of Michigan|Governor]] [[Gretchen Whitmer]] orders all K–12 schools in the state to close from March 16–April 5 as well as banning gatherings of over 250 people. [https://www.mlive.com/public-interest/2020/03/michigan-gov-gretchen-whitmer-bans-gatherings-of-more-than-250-people-as-coronavirus-spreads.html (MLive.com)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Ohio]]
****After five cases of COVID-19 are confirmed in [[Ohio]], [[Governor of Ohio|Governor]] [[Mike DeWine]] orders all K–12 schools to close from March 16–April 5. [https://www.cleveland.com/news/2020/03/ohio-gov-dewine-announces-3-week-spring-break-for-ohio-schools-to-control-coronavirus.html (''Cleveland Plain Dealer'')]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Arkansas]]
****Five more presumptive cases of COVID-19 are reported in [[Arkansas]], prompting Governor [[Asa Hutchinson]] to order school closings in four counties. [https://www.arkansasonline.com/news/2020/mar/12/6-presumptive-positive-cases-coronavirus-arkansas/ (''The Arkansas Democrat-Gazette'')]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Alaska]]
****[[Alaska]] confirms its first presumptive case of COVID-19, with the patient identified as a foreign national residing in [[Anchorage, Alaska|Anchorage]]. [https://gov.alaska.gov/newsroom/2020/03/12/first-case-of-covid-19-confirmed-by-alaska-state-public-health-laboratory-is-an-international-resident/ (Alaska Government)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Colorado]]
****The [[University of Colorado Boulder]] confirms its first presumptive case of COVID-19, identified as an employee who worked in the dining center. [https://www.dailycamera.com/2020/03/12/cu-boulder-confirms-employee-tested-presumptive-positive-for-covid-19/ (''Boulder Daily Camera'')]
****School districts across the state close due to coronavirus concerns. [https://www.denverpost.com/2020/03/11/colorado-schools-closed-coronavirus/ (''The Denver Post'')]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Delaware]]
****[[Delaware]] Governor [[John Carney (politician)|John Carney]] declares a state of emergency and recommends the cancellation of all non-essential public gatherings of over 100 people. [http://www.wboc.com/story/41888267/governor-carney-declares-state-of-emergency-amidst-coronavirus-outbreak (WBOC)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Bolivia]]
***Interim [[President of Bolivia]] [[Jeanine Áñez]] announces the suspension of all flights to Europe from March 14. [https://www.efe.com/efe/america/economia/bolivia-suspende-desde-el-sabado-los-vuelos-con-europa-por-coronavirus/20000011-4194522 (EFE)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Malta]]
***[[Prime Minister of Malta]] [[Robert Abela]] calls for the closing of all educational centers for one week from March 13. [https://timesofmalta.com/articles/view/coronavirus-schools-childcare-centres-university-to-shut-down-for-a.777521 (Times of Malta)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Portugal]]
***Portuguese Government calls for the closure of all schools and night clubs. [https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2020-03-12/portugal-orders-schools-night-clubs-shut-due-to-coronavirus (USNews)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Israel]]
***The [[Israel Institute for Biological Research]] announces it is working on a [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]. [https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/.premium-israeli-research-center-to-announce-it-developed-coronavirus-vaccine-sources-say-1.8665074 (Haaretz)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
***The first case of COVID-19 is found in the [[Cayman Islands]]. [http://www.loopcayman.com/content/first-case-covid-19-confirmed-cayman-islands (Loop Cayman)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Armenia]]
***Armenian Government orders the shut down of all schools until 23 March. [https://armenpress.am/eng/news/1008370/ (Armen Press)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United States]]
**[[Mitch McConnell]] announces that the [[United States Senate]] will not have recess to work on a bill to contain the coronavirus. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/03/12/politics/congress-recess-canceled/index.html (CNN)]

;Sports
*[[Impact of the 2019–20 coronavirus pandemic on sports]]
** The [[National Collegiate Athletic Association|NCAA]], which had previously ordered that all of its winter championship events, most notably the [[NCAA Division I|Division I]] [[2020 NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Tournament|men]]'s and [[2020 NCAA Division I Women's Basketball Tournament|women]]'s basketball tournaments, would be played with no spectators, cancels all championship events until the 2020–21 academic year. This affects more than 70 of the NCAA's 90 championship events in all three of its competitive divisions. [https://www.ncaa.org/about/resources/media-center/news/ncaa-cancels-remaining-winter-and-spring-championships (NCAA)]
**The [[YMCA]] [[Short course|Short Course]] Nationals swim meet is canceled in the United States for the first time since 1947. [https://swimswam.com/ymca-short-course-nationals-canceled-for-first-time-since-1947/ (Swim Swam)]
**[[2020 Summer Olympics torch relay]]
***The Olympic torch relay begins in [[Olympia, Greece]], without public attendance. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/sports/amid-virus-precautions-tokyo-olympic-flame-is-lit-in-greece-1.4849843 (CTV News)] 
**The [[12 Hours of Sebring]] is postponed until November 11–14. This follows an announcement that the companion event [[1000 Miles of Sebring]] would be cancelled. [https://www.roadandtrack.com/motorsports/a31435154/2020-sebring-12-hours-postponed-coronavirus/ (''Road & Track'')] [https://racer.com/2020/03/12/imsa-postpones-sebring-until-november/ (RACER)]
**[[2019–20 NHL season]]
***The [[National Hockey League]] announces the suspension of its season. [https://www.nhl.com/news/nhl-coronavirus-status/c-316155530 (NHL)]
**[[2020 Major League Soccer season]]
***Major League Soccer announces it will suspend its season for thirty days. [https://www.espn.com/soccer/major-league-soccer/story/4073255/mls-postponed-for-30-days-usmnt-uswnt-friendlies-canceled (ESPN)]
**[[2020 Major League Baseball season]]	
***[[Major League Baseball]] announces the cancellation of all remaining [[spring training]] games and the delay of [[Opening Day]] of the regular season by at least two weeks. [https://www.mlb.com/news/mlb-2020-season-delayed (MLB)]	
**[[2020 LPGA Tour]] and [[2019–20 PGA Tour]]	
***The [[LPGA]] announces that the first three events of its season—including the [[ANA Inspiration]], the season's first [[Women's major golf championships|major championship]]—have been postponed due to the coronavirus. [https://www.cbssports.com/golf/news/coronavirus-update-lpga-postpones-first-three-events-on-calendar-for-2020/ (CBS Sports)]	
***The [[PGA Tour]] cancels [[The Players Championship]] and the next three tour events. [https://nypost.com/2020/03/12/pga-cancels-the-players-championship-multiple-tour-events/ (''New York Post'')]
**[[Chinese Professional Baseball League]] Commissioner [[John Wu (politician)|John Wu]] announces that the opening game of the 2020 season will be postponed until 11 April. [https://www.ftvnews.com.tw/news/detail/2020312A07M1 (FTV)]
<!-- All news items above this line -->}}
